days.title: 8 个单元音，星期和月份
days.teacher: 欢迎来上第一课！今天的目标很简单：认识 8 个元音，记住星期和月份。发音不标准完全没关系，第一天只要"认识它们"就赢了。

a.title: 音标：8 个单元音（上）
单词：星期和月份（25 个）
words: 星期三（第一个 d 不发音）

a.title: 语法：词性，每个词都有自己的"工种"
lesson: 英语的词按作用分成几类，叫"词性"。认识词性，是看懂句子的第一步。今天先认识最常用的 6 种：
mother 母亲，book 书，March 三月
cheap 便宜的，big 大的，kind 善良的
描述动作"怎么做、多经常"
usually 通常，very 非常，early 早
放在名词前，表示时间、位置
in 在……里，on 在……上，at 在
and 和，but 但是，because 因为
来看一个句子里的分工：
mother 和 dinner 是名词，usually 是副词，cooks 是动词。
背单词时顺便看一眼词性（n. v. adj. adv.），以后造句就不容易用错。
quiz: cheap 描述东西"便宜"，是形容词。
She works on Monday. 这句里的 works 是？
works 表示"工作"这个动作，是动词。
I often cook. 这句里的 often 是？
often 说明做饭"多经常"，是副词。
My birthday is in May. 这句里的 in 是？
in 放在 May 前面表示时间，是介词。
I like tea but she likes coffee. 这句里的 but 是？
but 把两个句子连起来，是连词。
我喜欢茶，但她喜欢咖啡。

b.title: 听写：5 句话
items: I have an English class on Monday.
The course starts on the fifth of September.

passage.title: My Week
passage.text: Hi, I'm Lily. I work from Monday to Friday. On Monday and Wednesday, I go to an English class after work. Thursday is my busy day. On Friday evening, I relax with my friends. The weekend is my favourite time. On Saturday, I sleep late. On Sunday, I call my parents. My birthday is in March, and I love spring. Today is Tuesday. Tomorrow is Wednesday, so I have an English class!
quiz: How many days does Lily work every week?
from Monday to Friday，周一到周五，一共五天。
When does Lily have English classes?
原文：On Monday and Wednesday, I go to an English class.
Lily 什么时候上英语课？
原文：My birthday is in March.
Lily 的生日在什么时候？
parse: On Friday evening, I relax with my friends.
I relax（我放松）。On Friday evening 说时间，with my friends 说和谁一起。
周五晚上，我和朋友们一起放松。
My birthday is in March, and I love spring.
两个句子用 and 连起来：My birthday is in March + I love spring。
我的生日在三月，我很喜欢春天。
passage.zh: 你好，我是 Lily。我周一到周五上班。周一和周三下班后，我去上英语课。周四是我很忙的一天。周五晚上，我和朋友们一起放松。周末是我最喜欢的时间：周六我睡懒觉，周日给爸妈打电话。我的生日在三月，我很喜欢春天。今天是星期二，明天是星期三，所以我有英语课！

b.title: 听辨游戏：ship 还是 sheep？（船还是羊）

c.title: 写 5 句话
items: I work from Monday to Friday.
周末是我最喜欢的时间。
The weekend is my favourite time.

c.title: 口语：你最喜欢星期几？为什么？

speak.q: What day of the week do you like best? Why?
speak.zh: 你最喜欢星期几？为什么？
speak.model: I like Saturday best. On Saturday I don't work, so I can sleep late. In the afternoon, I usually meet my friends or go shopping. It is the most relaxing day of my week.
phrases: On Saturday I don't work, so …
It is the most relaxing day of my week.
这是我一周里最放松的一天。
speak.tip: Part 1 的万能结构：直接回答，加一个原因，再加一个小细节。说 2 到 4 句就够了。
speak.modelZh: 我最喜欢星期六。周六我不上班，所以可以睡懒觉。下午我通常和朋友见面或者去购物。这是我一周里最放松的一天。

days.title: 最后 4 个单元音和 4 个双元音，数字和价钱
days.teacher: 昨天的 8 个元音还记得吗？今天我们学会"滑动"的双元音，就是 day、my、boy 里的那种音。另外，thirteen 和 thirty 是雅思听力最爱考的陷阱之一，今天就把它拿下。

a.title: 音标：4 个单元音和 4 个双元音
单词：数字和价钱（25 个）
words: v. 花费 n. 费用
n. 总数 adj. 总的

a.title: 语法：句子的骨架：主语和谓语
lesson: 每个英语句子都有一副"骨架"：谁（主语）加上做什么或怎么样（谓语动词）。找到这两样，再长的句子也不怕。
我工作。主语 I，谓语 work。
我姐姐住在伦敦。主语 My sister，谓语 lives。
价格很低（很便宜）。主语 The price，谓语 is。
很多动词后面还要跟一个"宾语"，也就是动作的对象。pay 是"付"，付什么？the bill 就是宾语：
英语句子一般不能没有主语。中文可以说"很便宜"，英语要说"It is cheap."，那个 It 不能省。
quiz: My father drives a bus. 主语是？
My father drives a bus. 谓语动词是？
My father drives a bus. 宾语是？
The shop opens at nine. 主语是？
下面哪句是完整的英语句子？
要有主语 It 和谓语 is。
We study English together. 谓语动词是？

b.title: 听写：5 句话
items: The total is two hundred and fifteen pounds.
The shop opens at a quarter past nine.

passage.title: At the Market
passage.text: Every Saturday morning, Tom goes to the market near his home. The fruit there is cheap and fresh. Today, a kilo of apples is two pounds, and a bunch of bananas is one pound fifty. Tom buys a kilo of apples and a bunch of bananas. The total is three pounds fifty. He pays in cash. The shop next door has a discount on Saturdays, so he also buys a cheap umbrella for five pounds.
quiz: When does Tom go to the market?
How much is a kilo of apples?
a kilo of apples is two pounds，两英镑。
parse: The fruit there is cheap and fresh.
The fruit is cheap and fresh（主语 + is + 形容词）。there 跟在 fruit 后面，表示"那里的"水果。
那里的水果又便宜又新鲜。
The shop next door has a discount on Saturdays, so he also buys a cheap umbrella.
The shop has a discount + so + he buys an umbrella。next door 修饰 shop，so 引出结果。
隔壁的商店周六打折，所以他还买了一把便宜的伞。
passage.zh: 每个周六早上，Tom 都去家附近的市场。那里的水果又便宜又新鲜。今天，一公斤苹果两英镑，一串香蕉一英镑五十便士。Tom 买了一公斤苹果和一串香蕉，一共三英镑五十便士。他用现金付款。隔壁的商店周六打折，所以他还花五英镑买了一把便宜的雨伞。

b.title: 听辨游戏：full 还是 fool？（满的还是傻瓜）

speak.model: Yes, I do. I like shopping for clothes, especially when there is a discount. I usually shop online because it is cheap and easy. But sometimes I go to the shopping centre with my friends at the weekend.
speak.tip: 回答 Yes 或 No 以后一定要接着说原因，只说一个 Yes 是口语考试的大忌。
speak.modelZh: 是的，我喜欢。我喜欢买衣服，尤其是打折的时候。我通常在网上买，因为便宜又方便。但有时候周末我会和朋友去购物中心。

days.title: 最后 4 个双元音和第一批辅音，家人和朋友
days.teacher: 今天开始学辅音啦。聊家人是口语考试的常客，今天学的词，下周就能用在你自己的回答里。傍晚记得录一段"我的家"，一周后回来听，你会惊讶自己的进步。

a.title: 音标：4 个双元音和 4 个辅音
单词：家人和朋友（25 个）
words: n. 孩子们（child 的复数）

a.title: 语法：be 动词：am、is、are
lesson: be 动词相当于中文的"是"，也可以表示"在"，或者描述状态。它会跟着主语变形：
he 他 / she 她 / it 它 / 单数名词
you 你（们）/ we 我们 / they 他们 / 复数名词
她很善良。中文说"很善良"，英语里必须有 is。
否定：在 be 后面加 not。疑问：把 be 放到句首。
缩写很常用：I'm = I am，she's = she is，they're = they are，isn't = is not，aren't = are not。
quiz: My mother 是单数，用 is。
I 只和 am 搭配。
形容词前面要有 be 动词。
把 You are free. 变成疑问句：

b.title: 听写：5 句话
items: There are four people in my family.
We have dinner together every Sunday.
我们每周日一起吃晚饭。

passage.title: My Family
passage.text: There are five people in my family: my parents, my grandmother, my little brother and me. My father is a driver, and my mother works in a hospital. My grandmother is seventy-two, but she walks in the park every morning. My brother is ten. He is funny and he loves football. We don't live with my aunt and uncle, but we have dinner together every Sunday. I love my family because they are kind to me.
quiz: How many people are there in the family?
原文：There are five people in my family。
my mother works in a hospital。
When do they have dinner with the aunt and uncle?
we have dinner together every Sunday。
他们什么时候和阿姨、叔叔一起吃晚饭？
parse: My grandmother is seventy-two, but she walks in the park every morning.
My grandmother is seventy-two + but + she walks。but 表示转折。
我奶奶七十二岁了，但她每天早上都去公园散步。
I love my family because they are kind to me.
I love my family；because 引出原因：they are kind to me。
我爱我的家人，因为他们对我很好。
passage.zh: 我家有五口人：我爸爸妈妈、我奶奶、我弟弟和我。我爸爸是司机，我妈妈在医院工作。我奶奶七十二岁了，但她每天早上都去公园散步。我弟弟十岁，他很有趣，也很喜欢足球。我们不和阿姨、叔叔住在一起，但每周日都一起吃晚饭。我爱我的家人，因为他们对我很好。

b.title: 听辨游戏：coat 还是 caught？（外套还是抓住）

c.title: 写 5 句话
items: There are three people in my family.
我和朋友们一起吃午饭。
I have lunch with my friends.

speak.model: There are four people in my family: my parents, my younger brother and me. My father works in a bank, and my mother is a teacher. We are very close. We usually have dinner together and talk about our day.
phrases: There are … people in my family.
speak.tip: 换成你自己家的真实情况再说一遍，真实的内容最容易说流利。
speak.modelZh: 我家有四口人：我爸爸妈妈、我弟弟和我。我爸爸在银行工作，我妈妈是老师。我们关系很亲，通常一起吃晚饭，聊聊一天的事情。

days.title: /θ/ 和 /ð/ 等 8 个辅音，家和租房
days.teacher: 今天的 /θ/ 和 /ð/ 是中国同学最容易发错的两个音，大胆把舌头伸出来，别害羞！租房是雅思听力第一部分的高频场景，听写要好好练。

a.title: 音标：8 个辅音（含最难的 /θ/ 和 /ð/）
单词：家和租房（25 个）
语法：一般现在时：说习惯和事实
lesson: 说"平时、经常、总是"做的事，或者一个事实，用一般现在时，动词用原形：
I usually get up at seven.
重点来了：主语是 he、she、it 或者单数名词时，动词要加 -s 或 -es。这叫"第三人称单数"，是写作里最常见的扣分点之一。
My brother watches TV every evening.
我弟弟每天晚上看电视。watch 以 ch 结尾，加 -es。
他十二点吃午饭。have 变成 has，要单独记。
否定和疑问用 do 或 does，用了 does，后面的动词就回到原形：
看到 usually（通常）、always（总是）、often（经常）、sometimes（有时）、never（从不）、every day（每天），就想到一般现在时。
quiz: she 是第三人称单数，动词加 -s。
they 是复数，用原形 have。
My father ___ TV in the evening.
watch 以 ch 结尾，加 -es。
your sister 是单数，用 Does。
He go to work by bus.
He goes to work by bus.
He going to work by bus.

b.title: 听写：5 句话
items: I live in a small flat.
The rent is five hundred pounds a month.
My address is eight Park Street.
我的地址是公园街 8 号。
The kitchen is small but the living room is big.
Is the flat near a bus stop?
这套公寓离公交站近吗？

b.title: 阅读：Looking for a Flat（找公寓）

passage.title: Looking for a Flat
passage.text: Anna is a student, and she is looking for a flat near her university. She visits a flat on Green Street. It has one bedroom, a small kitchen and a bathroom. There is no garden, but the living room is big and comfortable. The rent is six hundred and fifty pounds a month. The landlord is friendly, and the neighbourhood is quiet. Anna likes the flat, and she wants to move in next month.
quiz: 原文：She visits a flat on Green Street。
six hundred and fifty 是 650。雅思听力很爱这样考数字。
What does the flat NOT have?
parse: Anna is a student, and she is looking for a flat near her university.
Anna is a student + she is looking for a flat。near her university 修饰 a flat：在她大学附近的公寓。
安娜是个学生，她正在找一套离大学近的公寓。
There is no garden, but the living room is big and comfortable.
There is no garden（there be 句型：某处有或没有某物）+ but + the living room is big and comfortable。
没有花园，但客厅又大又舒服。
passage.zh: 安娜是个学生，她正在找一套离大学近的公寓。她去看了 Green 街上的一套公寓：有一间卧室、一个小厨房和一个浴室。没有花园，但客厅又大又舒服。房租每月六百五十英镑。房东很友好，周边也很安静。安娜喜欢这套公寓，想下个月搬进去。

b.title: 听辨游戏：coat 还是 goat？（外套还是山羊）

c.title: 写 5 句话
items: There is a park near my home.

c.title: 口语：你住独栋房子还是公寓？

speak.q: Do you live in a house or a flat?
speak.zh: 你住独栋房子还是公寓？
speak.model: I live in a flat in the city centre. It is not very big, but it is comfortable. I love my bedroom because it is quiet and it has a big window. The neighbourhood is convenient, with lots of shops and restaurants.
phrases: I live in a flat in …
It is not very big, but …
speak.tip: 描述地方的万能顺序：在哪里，大不大，你最喜欢哪里，周边怎么样。
speak.modelZh: 我住在市中心的一套公寓里。它不是很大，但很舒服。我很喜欢我的卧室，因为它很安静，还有一扇大窗户。周边很方便，有很多商店和餐馆。

days.title: /r/ 和 /ʃ/ 等 8 个辅音，日常作息
days.teacher: 坚持到第 5 天了，给自己比个心！今天的 /r/ 和 /l/、/ʃ/ 和 /s/ 都是容易混的"难兄难弟"，多听几遍，对比着学。

a.title: 音标：8 个辅音（含 /r/ 和 /tr/ /dr/）
单词：日常作息（25 个）
words: v. 打扫 adj. 干净的
adv. 经常（t 通常不发音）
v. 走路；散步（l 不发音）

a.title: 语法：名词单复数，a、an 和 the
lesson: 可数名词分单数和复数。复数一般加 -s：book 变成 books。以 s、x、ch、sh 结尾的加 -es：bus 变成 buses，box 变成 boxes。
有些要单独记：child（孩子）变成 children，man（男人）变成 men，woman（女人）变成 women，person（人）变成 people（人们）。
不可数名词没有复数，前面也不能用 a：furniture（家具）、homework（家庭作业）、money（钱）、water（水）。
a 和 an 表示"一个"。看的是读音，不是字母：辅音开头用 a，元音开头用 an。
a desk, an apple, an hour
一张桌子、一个苹果、一个小时。hour 的 h 不发音，读音以元音开头，所以用 an。
一所大学。university 读音以 /j/ 开头，是辅音，所以用 a。
the 表示"特指的那一个"，前面提过的、双方都知道的东西用 the：
I have a flat. The flat is near the park.
我有一套公寓。这套公寓在公园附近。
quiz: child 的复数是 children，要单独记。
umbrella 以元音音素开头，用 an。
university 读音以 /j/ 开头，用 a。
furniture 不可数，没有复数，也不能加 a。
I have a cat. ___ cat is very funny.
前面提过的那只猫，用 The。
我有一只猫。这只猫很有趣。

b.title: 听写：5 句话
items: I usually get up at seven.
I am busy in the morning.
He never goes to bed late.
We sometimes walk in the park after lunch.
我们有时午饭后去公园散步。

b.title: 阅读：A Busy Day（忙碌的一天）

passage.title: A Busy Day
passage.text: Mia is a nurse. She usually gets up at six o'clock. She has a quick shower and eats breakfast at half past six. She goes to work by bus, and the bus ride takes forty minutes. At work, she is always busy. She has lunch at one o'clock. After work, she often walks in the park to relax. In the evening, she cooks dinner, reads a book and goes to bed early. She never watches TV late at night.
quiz: What time does Mia get up?
She usually gets up at six o'clock。六点半是吃早饭的时间。
How long is the bus ride?
What does Mia do after work?
After work, she often walks in the park。
parse: She goes to work by bus, and the bus ride takes forty minutes.
She goes to work + the bus ride takes forty minutes。by bus 说明方式。
她坐公交上班，车程四十分钟。
In the evening, she cooks dinner, reads a book and goes to bed early.
一个主语 she，带了三个动作 cooks、reads、goes，用逗号和 and 连起来。
晚上，她做晚饭、看书，然后早早睡觉。
passage.zh: Mia 是一名护士。她通常六点起床，快速洗个澡，六点半吃早餐。她坐公交上班，车程四十分钟。上班时她总是很忙，一点吃午饭。下班后，她经常去公园散步放松一下。晚上，她做晚饭、看书，然后早早睡觉。她从不熬夜看电视。

b.title: 听辨游戏：see 还是 she？（看见还是她）

c.title: 写 5 句话
items: I usually get up at seven.
I am busy at the weekend.

c.title: 口语：你早上通常做什么？

speak.q: What do you usually do in the morning?
speak.model: I usually get up at seven. First, I have a shower, and then I have a quick breakfast, usually eggs and coffee. After that, I study English for two hours, because the morning is the best time for me to learn.
phrases: … is the best time for me to …
speak.tip: 说顺序时用 first、then、after that 串起来，听起来马上就有条理了。
speak.modelZh: 我通常七点起床。先洗个澡，然后快速吃个早餐，一般是鸡蛋和咖啡。之后我学两个小时英语，因为早上是我学习的最佳时间。

days.title: 最后 8 个辅音，学习和工作
days.teacher: 最后 8 个音标！学完今天，48 个音标就全部认识了，这一步很多人拖了好几年，你一周就完成了。明天是复习日，不学新东西。

a.title: 音标：最后 8 个辅音
单词：学习和工作（25 个）
语法：五种基本句型
lesson: 英语句子虽然千变万化，骨架只有 5 种。认出骨架，长句就好拆了。
2. 主语 + 谓语 + 宾语
3. 主语 + 系动词 + 表语
公寓很安静。is 把主语和描述它的 quiet 连起来。
4. 主语 + 谓语 + 两个宾语
My mother gave me a book.
妈妈给了我一本书。me 和 a book 都是宾语。
5. 主语 + 谓语 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语
这个消息让她很开心。happy 补充说明 her。
找骨架三步：先找谓语动词，再往前找主语，最后往后看它还需要什么（宾语？表语？两个宾语？）。
quiz: The kitchen is small. 是哪种句型？
主语 + 系动词 + 表语
主语 + 谓语 + 宾语
is 是系动词，small 是表语。
We study English. 是哪种句型？
主语 + 谓语 + 宾语
主语 + 系动词 + 表语
study 的对象是 English，English 是宾语。
He sent me a message. 里的 me 和 a message 是？
给谁（me），给什么（a message），都是宾语。
The baby cried. 是哪种句型？
主语 + 谓语 + 宾语
主语 + 系动词 + 表语
This job makes me tired. 里的 tired 是？
tired 补充说明 me 的状态。
下面哪句是"主语 + 系动词 + 表语"？
is 连接 My sister 和 a nurse。

passage.title: A New Job
passage.text: Sam is twenty-three, and he has a degree in computer science. Now he works at a small company in the city centre. His boss, Helen, is kind, and his colleagues are helpful. Sam likes his job and his salary is good, but he wants more experience. Every Tuesday and Thursday evening, he takes an online course. He wants to learn new skills and build a great career. Next year, he wants to apply for a job as a manager.
quiz: Sam 是什么专业的学位？
His boss, Helen：Helen 是他的老板。
When does Sam take his online course?
原文：Every Tuesday and Thursday evening。
parse: His boss, Helen, is kind, and his colleagues are helpful.
His boss is kind + his colleagues are helpful。Helen 放在两个逗号中间，补充说明老板的名字。
他的老板 Helen 人很好，同事们也乐于帮忙。
Next year, he wants to apply for a job as a manager.
he wants to apply for a job。as a manager 说明是什么职位。
明年，他想申请一个经理的职位。
passage.zh: Sam 二十三岁，有计算机科学的学位。现在他在市中心的一家小公司工作。他的老板 Helen 人很好，同事们也乐于帮忙。Sam 喜欢他的工作，工资也不错，但他想要更多经验。每周二和周四晚上，他都上一门网课。他想学新技能，打造一份好事业。明年，他想申请一个经理的职位。

c.title: 口语：你是上班还是读书？

speak.q: Do you work or are you a student?
speak.model: At the moment, I am preparing for the IELTS exam, so studying English is my main job! I want to study abroad next year, so I spend most of my time learning English.
phrases: I spend most of my time …
speak.tip: 按你的真实情况改：比如想出国工作就说 I want to work abroad，想移民就说 I want to move to another country。
speak.modelZh: 目前我在准备雅思考试，所以学英语就是我的主要工作！我想明年出国留学，所以我大部分时间都在学英语。

b.title: 语法综合小测
lesson: 这一周学了词性、主语和谓语、be 动词、一般现在时、名词单复数和冠词、五种基本句型。做一做下面 10 道题，看看哪里还要补。
quiz: The rent 是单数，用 is。
My parents ___ in a small house.
My parents 是复数，动词用原形。
我父母住在一栋小房子里。
She ___ breakfast at half past seven.
she 后面 have 要变成 has。
interview 以元音音素开头，用 an。
usually 说明"多经常"，是副词。
My colleague is funny. 是哪种句型？
主语 + 系动词 + 表语
主语 + 谓语 + 宾语
is 是系动词，funny 是表语。
he 是第三人称单数，用 Does。
二十张桌子要用复数 desks。
我们教室有二十张桌子。

c.title: 口语：你周末喜欢做什么？

speak.q: What do you like to do at the weekend?
speak.model: At the weekend, I like to relax. On Saturday morning I sleep late, and in the afternoon I often go for a walk in the park. On Sunday I usually cook a nice lunch for my family. Sometimes I watch a film in the evening.
speak.tip: 把这一周学过的句型都用上试试：usually、often、sometimes，还有 first、then、after that。
speak.modelZh: 周末我喜欢放松一下。周六早上我睡懒觉，下午经常去公园散步。周日我通常给家人做一顿好吃的午饭。有时候晚上会看一部电影。
